title: No-Go Theorem for BEC in the Nelson and Pauli--Fierz Models
summary: We construct KMS states for the Nelson model, the spinless Pauli--Fierz model, and the Pauli--Fierz model with spin by functional integral representations, and study point-source models after removal of the infrared and ultraviolet cutoffs. If the physical test-function space can distinguish the zero mode, the absence of off-diagonal long-range order, the vanishing of the zero-mode form, the vanishing of the condensate density, the order-parameter criterion, and the triviality of the BEC directions and the BEC ideal are equivalent.
